copy.tagline: 用 Chat SDK 接入 WhatsApp 官方消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要接入 WhatsApp 消息的应用。
copy.tagline_en: Add WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel via Chat SDK
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app that needs WhatsApp messaging.

howto.what: Claude 会把 WhatsApp Cloud 适配器复制进 src/channels/、注册到通道入口、安装固定版本依赖，再跑构建和注册测试验证。之后经 Meta 官方 API 收发 1:1 WhatsApp 消息。
howto.when: 当你要让 NanoClaw 接入 WhatsApp，或提到「whatsapp-cloud」渠道时接管；若你正在跑 /setup，安装完会回到该流程。

say.text: 帮我把 WhatsApp Cloud 渠道装上
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册、装依赖并构建测试

say.text: 把 WhatsApp Cloud 的四个凭证写进 .env
跑一下 whatsapp-cloud 的注册测试
say.note: 检查入口导入和依赖是否漂移

howto.what_en: Claude copies the WhatsApp Cloud adapter into src/channels/, registers it in the channel barrel, installs the pinned @chat-adapter/whatsapp dependency, then builds and runs the registration test.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to connect NanoClaw to WhatsApp or mention the whatsapp-cloud channel; if you're mid-/setup, it returns to the setup flow afterwards.

say_en.note: Copies adapter, registers it, installs, builds

say_en.text: Write the four WhatsApp credentials to .env
say_en.note: Prompts for token, Phone Number ID, etc.
Checks barrel import and dependency drift
